text:
tara (PM): Rapid capture — final GA acceptance well show in the roadmap review. Need explicit ops handback steps, rollback criteria, SLA wording for legal, minimum public docs, monitoring minima, and billing stance.
leo (Eng): Ops handback proposal: 48h soft monitoring window post-rollout where Eng + SRE co-paginate; after that SRE takes ownership. Also implement a traffic-cordon command to freeze new model promotions.
anya (SRE): Rollback criteria: auto-rollback if error-rate >0.4% sustained 6m OR p95 latency >2x baseline for 5m. Manual rollback if synthetic failures in >=2 regions for 3 consecutive checks. Well add a "quarantine" tag to bad model revisions to prevent accidental promote.
jo (Docs): Public docs gating: GA requires Quickstart, Troubleshooting FAQ (2 pages), and a short "how-we-measure-latency" section. Internal runbook (incident flows + runbook play actions) must be in private docs within 7 business days.
priya (FinOps): Billing stance: self-serve pricing marked "indicative" for GA; well run shadow billing (no invoices) for 72h to validate pipeline. Committed/discounted tiers behind sales and require E2E billing tests (2 business days).
legal-bot: Legal: SLA remedy = billing credits capped at affected-month invoice; require explicit definition of "service unavailability" (recommend: sustained 5xx >0.5% OR streaming timeouts >30s). Include 30-day API-change notice and force majeure.
tara (PM): Monitoring minima: p50/p95 latency per-route, per-model token-cost metric, cache-hit rate, per-route error-rate. Alerts to create: A) p95 > baseline * 1.8 for 5m, B) error-rate >0.5% for 6m, C) cache-hit < 70% for 10m, D) synthetic fails in >=2 regions.
leo (Eng): Can add a minimal runbook snippet to public FAQ for "what to do on high latency":
```
1) Check /metrics latency p95 by route
2) Verify cache-hit % and last restart
3) If error-rate high, toggle fallback-model-routing
4) Escalate to SRE if not resolved in 15m
```
anya (SRE): Oncall rotation: GA week SRE primary 24/7; product lead joins first 2 hours of any P0 incident for RCA triage. We'll include an escalation matrix in the internal runbook. Also request 90d traces and 365d alert metadata for postmortems.
jo (Docs): I'll make the Quickstart and the 2-page FAQ template and include a worked token-cost example: "100 tokens * $0.0008 = $0.08". ETA: EOD today for drafts.
priya (FinOps): I'll kick off shadow billing during canary and run the E2E billing test once canary hits 50% traffic. Report back Wed.
leo (Eng): One more ops control: add a "traffic cordon" role to block self-serve deployments for 24h if we see instability. I'll add RBAC for that.
tara (PM): Ok decision summary to lock for roadmap: SLA: availability objective 99.9% monthly, remedies = capped billing credits; Rollback: auto and manual criteria above; Docs: Quickstart + FAQ required for GA, internal runbook within 7 business days; Monitoring: p50/p95, token-cost, cache-hit, per-route errors + alerts listed; Billing: indicative pricing + shadow billing for validation; Ops: 48h soft handback then SRE ownership, traffic-cordon control, quarantine tag for bad revisions.
anya (SRE): +1 pending exact "service unavailability" sentence for legal. I'll post wording in 2h.
jo (Docs): +1. Drafts incoming.
leo (Eng): +1. PRs for cordon + quarantine + rollback automation in flight.
priya (FinOps): +1 on shadow billing plan.
tara (PM): Thanks all. I'll produce the one-pager with these bullets and mark known blockers: legal phrase, billing E2E. If anything fires during canary, call it out here and well pause rollout. :fire_engine:
